horoscope: The Sun and Uranus face off today, dear Aries, as they do once a year, and this comes just after a Full Moon. Changes in plans can lead to discoveries, perspectives, and insight that truly improve your life, so don't dig in your heels too much. Instead, be open to change, but try not to make sudden moves until you know your heart on a matter. An epiphany or moment of truth can be disruptive but also relieving, refreshing, and revealing. Opposition to your ideas or plans can go one way or the other, but either way, you know where you stand. This is a powerful time to learn more about yourself. With the Sun and Pluto connecting harmoniously, you might reach a new level of connection with a friend. If a relationship no longer supports your growth, change is necessary, and you may be interested in rebuilding from the ground up. Pluto doesn't count superficial efforts and band-aid fixes. This is a time for digging deep. It's a good time for those who are studying, as you might learn something valuable, and for those pursuing a personal interest, as you may take it to another level. You might be contributing something unique to a group or sharing your expertise with associates, and this can eventually lead to advancement. You can be especially persuasive with others today.

There can be tension brewing today, dear Taurus, with the Sun opposite Uranus on this day after a Full Moon. It's most likely to center around money, ownership matters, sharing, or power dynamics for you. Whether someone owes you respect or money, the situation can come to a head. Material or non-material (such as emotional) debts can be hot topics now. Aim to be an innovator rather than a rebel for best results under this influence. While there can be unexpected events that try your patience, they can also reveal much about what kinds of changes you need to make to improve your life, particularly when it comes to relationships and finances. Pressures from others or a sense that you're weighed down by obligations can motivate you to become more self-reliant, for example. The day is emotionally charged. Fortunately, there can be new insights into a career or research project, your financial affairs, or intimate matters today, and they get you ahead of the game. You’re likely to discover or rekindle your passion for something (and perhaps someone). With today’s Sun-Pluto transit, the focus now is on growing, improving, and using your resources sensibly.

With the Sun in your opposite sign opposing Uranus in your own sign, dear Gemini, you may be dealing with resistance or opposition to your ideas or plans today. The need to reach a compromise may become apparent now, but it is not especially easy! There could be an important discovery about a relationship, and people in your life can trigger issues of freedom and independence that you need to explore. The Sun's annual opposition to Uranus right after a Full Moon in your sign can point to important messages. You are challenged to find the right balance between partnership and independence. Reacting is easy, but learning from your experiences is the smart move now. Innovate for best results now. Express your appreciation for people who matter most to you, especially if you're also driven to assert your independence. Also today, Pluto boosts your sense of purpose as it forms a harmonious aspect to the Sun in your partnership sector. You may very well feel more purposeful through a significant other now. A shared vision or something to work towards can bond you. Although you could be feeling a little restless in spots today, you're likely to end the day feeling you've accomplished something.

A yearly Sun-Uranus face-off occurs today, just after a Full Moon, dear Cancer, and this tends to affect your work and your mental or physical health. You may feel as if you are at the mercy of others' schedules, or something from your past may re-emerge, bringing a personal truth to light. You may very well discover what you've been missing in your life, and this sets you on a path to finding it. Certainly, some frustration can be stirring if you've been feeling restricted or overwhelmed. You are challenged to find a better balance between work and rest now, and it's definitely within reach. There is the element of surprise, rebellion, or change in the atmosphere around you today. Be the changemaker rather than have changes forced upon you. Today's Sun-Pluto aspect helps with this. You could find yourself resolving problems or facing challenges that you previously avoided. You're undoubtedly more determined to make improvements. You're also a bit more courageous and proactive now! You can arrive at an understanding about sharing power in a relationship or recognize the advantages of combining your talents or resources with someone else.

With a Sun-Uranus opposition today, just after a Full Moon, dear Leo, your usual routine is getting a bit of a shake-up, particularly in your social or romantic life. This will get you thinking and possibly moving towards positive change, even if, at first, there’s a little chaos. You might experience a conflict between a friend and a lover, but more likely, there can be a pull, disagreement, or discrepancy brought up that causes some tension. This can be about taking something to a new level now, whether it's an endeavor, idea, or a relationship. You can feel as if you come alive with a person, and putting a new spin on things improves your outlook. Look for opportunities to pour your heart into something meaningful and productive.

The Sun and Uranus form an opposition today, on this day after a Full Moon, dear Virgo, and both events highlight the need to make changes in your personal and professional life. With the Sun opposite Uranus today and a Full Moon just behind you, dear Libra, this can be a time for awakening to a new perspective, but it may take some mind-racing to get there. But while events or realizations occurring now can be a bit disruptive, they can also motivate you to make exciting changes. With the Sun opposite Uranus today, just after yesterday's Full Moon, dear Scorpio, you may face revelations and possible financial problems or tension. If you don't honestly know what's bothering you, you may end up instigating or provoking, so aim for self-understanding. The Sun-Uranus opposition today comes just after a Full Moon, dear Aquarius, charging the emotional atmosphere surrounding it. Life seems to be accelerating today, dear Pisces, and this can give you more courage to do something you've always wanted to do. Finding that often elusive balance between work and play, security and excitement, or professional and personal life, is not always easy, but events occurring now can motivate you to come close.
